notes.TWN: 賭場違法（刑法第 266 條賭博罪）；公益彩券合法，不得賣給未滿 18 歲的人（公益彩券發行條例第 9 條；條目寫 20 歲，跟法條不符）。離島可以經地方公投設觀光賭場（離島建設條例第 10-2 條），但條文要求的專法沒有制定，至今沒有賭場
notes.HKG: 條目寫香港有准許賭場的法律架構，但《賭博條例》只准賽馬、足球博彩與六合彩（香港賽馬會經營），沒有賭場
notes.JPN: 賽馬、競輪等公營賽事與彩券 20 歲、柏青哥 18 歲；2018 年的《綜合度假區整備法》准許設賭場，但還沒有開幕的
notes.IND: 1867 年的《公共賭博法》讓大多數地方禁止賭博，各邦另有規定（果阿、錫金准許賭場，多數邦有彩券）
notes.MYS: 21 歲；穆斯林全面禁止。雲頂是唯一的賭場
notes.USA: 依州而定：多數州有賭場或彩券，猶他州全面禁止
notes.MAC: 21 歲（彩券、運動彩券、賽事 18 歲）

notesEn.TWN: Casinos are illegal (gambling is an offence under Article 266 of the Criminal Code); the public welfare lottery is legal but may not be sold to anyone under 18 (Article 9 of the Public Welfare Lottery Issue Act; Wikipedia's 20 does not match the law). Outlying islands may allow casinos after a local referendum (Article 10-2 of the Offshore Islands Development Act), but the separate law it requires has never been passed, so there are no casinos
notesEn.HKG: Wikipedia says Hong Kong's laws allow casinos, but the Gambling Ordinance permits only horse racing, football betting and the Mark Six lottery (run by the Hong Kong Jockey Club); there are no casinos
notesEn.JPN: Public races and lotteries from 20 and pachinko from 18; the 2018 Integrated Resort Act allows casinos, but none has opened yet
notesEn.IND: The Public Gambling Act 1867 bans gambling in most of the country, with state laws on top (Goa and Sikkim allow casinos, and many states run lotteries)
notesEn.MYS: 21; banned for Muslims. Resorts World Genting is the only casino
notesEn.USA: Varies by state: most states have casinos or lotteries, while Utah bans all gambling
notesEn.MAC: 21 (18 for lotteries, sports betting and racing)
